entities.name: Mercy ffoulkes-Crabbe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mercy Kwarley ffoulkes-Crabbe, née Quartey-Papafio was a Ghanaian teacher, the first indigenous woman to head a school in the Gold Coast. She was also a women's columnist, under the pseudonym Gloria, for the Gold Coast Times.
